summary: Phase 1 (Backend Skeleton + Health Check) validated end-to-end. Backend supervisor process RUNNING; both /health (internal) and /api/health (external via ingress) return 200 with {"status":"ok","db":"connected"}; SQLite DB exists at /app/backend/data/btforcemanager.db with alembic_version table containing baseline revision e3c21f33f8fc; static React frontend still loads and renders force/mech data unchanged. 6/6 pytest tests pass.

integration_issues.issue: Console error on cold load: 'Error loading force file ghost-bear.json: TypeError: Failed to fetch'. The file exists on disk (public/data/forces/ghost-bear.json), is valid JSON, and returns 200 when fetched directly afterward -- likely a transient race/concurrent-fetch issue in loadForces() in useForceManager.js. App still functions (Bluefang Trinary force loads and renders 18 mechs correctly). PRE-EXISTING, unrelated to Phase 1 backend work.

action_items: (Non-blocking, pre-existing) Investigate transient 'Failed to fetch ghost-bear.json' console error in frontend/src/hooks/useForceManager.js loadForces() - possibly a Promise.all/concurrent fetch race with dev-server; not caused by Phase 1.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/.env DATABASE_URL points to sandbox absolute path (/app/backend/data/...). Confirmed .env.example and .env.docker.example templates exist for NAS deployment - good separation.
alembic env.py correctly converts sqlite+aiosqlite:// -> sqlite:// for sync driver during migrations - verified baseline migration ran cleanly.
server.py mounts /health both bare and under APIRouter(prefix='/api') so both routes share one handler - clean; matches ingress requirement that only /api-prefixed routes are exposed externally.

No frontend/.env with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exists yet - acceptable for Phase 1 since frontend is not wired to backend, but must be added before any future phase that consumes /api endpoints from the SPA.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_health.py (new - pytest suite for health endpoints, alembic baseline, and frontend smoke)
